error.auth.joke: 🔑 The brains don't recognise you. It's not personal.

error.auth_bad.joke: 🔑 Nice try. The brains have never seen that key in their lives.

error.server_down.joke: 🚬 All brains are on a smoke break.

error.rate_limit.joke: 🐌 Whoa — the brains' hands are UP. Too fast.

error.crash.joke: 💥 Brain meeting descended into chaos. A chair was thrown.

error.missing.joke: 🕳️ The brains searched every drawer. Nothing by that name.

query.empty.joke: Blank faces all round. A tumbleweed went past.

query.thinking.joke: 💭 Deep in thought — somewhere between Aristotle and 'where did I leave my keys.'

peek.intro.joke: 👀 Ever wondered what your AI actually gets told about you?

peek.result.joke: {brain} would pass along {chunks} — a light snack, not the whole fridge.

peek.result_big.joke: {brain} would pass along {chunks}. Your library's still a toddler, so that's most of it.

library.empty.joke: Blank faces all round. A tumbleweed went past.

library.welcome.joke: 👋 You've got a headful of brains and they're DYING to show you what they know.

search.none.joke: The brains looked at each other. Long pause.

fresh.stale_brain.joke: 😴 {brain}'s FADING— hasn't eaten since {date}— monkey's panicking— feed it—

fresh.all_good.joke: 🍽️ Every brain is fed and smug about it.

pulse.roster.joke: The brains line up. Each one's carrying something. Here's how they're doing.

milestone.first_memory.joke: 🎉 FIRST memory! {brain} framed it and hung it on the wall.

milestone.100_memories.joke: 🎉 {brain} just hit 100 memories. It's asking for a corner office.

easter.banana.joke: 🍌 BANANA! The monkey did a backflip. Morale is UP.
